youtube_title: Valparaiso's Old Porter County Jail: 1871, and the voices paranormal groups report
body: In Valparaiso, the 1871 Porter County Jail held prisoners for more than 100 years, and the sheriff and his family lived in the brick house attached to it. The jail closed in 1974 and became the county museum the next year. October ghost tours have told of haunted happenings in the old jail, and paranormal groups say they've recorded voices, and that doors open and close on their own. The museum moved out in 2020 and opened in a new home nearby in 2022. The old jail still stands on Franklin Street, just off the courthouse square. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Valparaiso #PorterCounty #Indiana #History #Haunted #LaPorteAfterDark

It was built in 1871, and the sheriff and his family lived in the brick house attached to it. The jail closed in 1974, and the next year it became the county museum.
October ghost tours have told of haunted happenings in the old jail, and paranormal groups say they've recorded voices, and that doors open and close on their own.
The museum moved out in 2020 and opened in its new home nearby in 2022. The old jail still stands on Franklin Street, just off the courthouse square.
